blurb: It isn't easy to break loose from the streamlined pace of modern living. It seems to follow you on the freeways and even crowd its way into most vacation spots. Crowded living isn't part of your stay at the Feather River Park Resort. It's one of the few places where you can escape to a simpler way of life.
